results.title: Fish Audio Launches Drama 3: Direct AI Voices in Plain Language, Control Every Word and Shift Emotion Mid-Sentence
results.content:
PALO ALTO, Calif., Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fish Audio, one of the fastest-growing AI platforms building expressive text-to-speech, speech-to-text and voice cloning, today launched Drama 3. This text-to-speech model lets developers, studios, and creators direct a voice performance instead of simply generating one. Users describe the desired tone, pacing, and character in plain language, then shape the performance with line-by-line precision until it's right. [...] Built to give developers, studios, and creators unprecedented control over voice performance, Drama 3 is designed for a wide range of applications, including audio dramas and interactive media, audiobooks and multilingual dubbing, games and animation, AI companion experiences, and content creation platforms. A drama studio can direct a two-character argument as a single scene, an audiobook narrator can shift from calm to trembling mid-sentence, and a game team can fix even a single word of dialogue without re-rendering the clip. Simply put, the model turns voice AI from something teams generate into something they can easily direct and edit. [...] "Voice AI has gotten very good at generating speech. The next step is directing a performance," said Rissa Cao, co-founder and CEO of Fish Audio. "Drama 3 is our most emotive and controllable model yet. It puts creators in the director's chair: describe what you want in plain language, listen back, and adjust only the moments that aren't working. That matters most in long-form projects like audiobooks and multilingual dubbing, where one wrong word shouldn't mean regenerating a whole chapter."

What is Fish Audio Drama 3?

Drama 3 is Fish Audio's newest text-to-speech model, with more feeling in every line than anything we've shipped. You direct it in plain words, in English or your own language, and it plays the line the way you describe. It's built for lines you render and keep, such as audiobooks, audio drama, game and animation dialogue, and short video. It speaks 83 languages, and it's available in Text to Speech on fish.audio, in the Fish Audio app for iOS and Android, and through the API with the model header drama-3.

What languages does Drama 3 support?

Drama 3 speaks 83 languages. You can write the direction in whatever language you think in; it doesn't have to match the language of the line.

results.title: Fish Audio Drama 3 Technical Report
results.content:
In this report, we present Fish Audio Drama 3, a speech generation model that turns text into directed performances. It clones voices from multiple references, follows natural-language direction, revises a take when the next turn gives a note, performs multi-character scenes, edits existing speech by infilling, and synthesizes long-form and streaming audio.
These capabilities rest on three design choices.
A hybrid linear-attention mixture-of-experts backbone is paired with a codebook multi-token-prediction decoder (Section 2) whose layers attend over the whole sequence, so acoustic detail is predicted with direct access to the reference audio and all previous frames. [...] Directable Performance. Drama 3 follows inline and scoped tags, style descriptions, and free-form director’s notes. Directing is multi-turn. When a take is not what the director wanted, the next turn gives a note such as [softer and warmer versus previous] and the model redoes the take, with the earlier takes kept in context.

Scenes and Dialogue. The model casts several voices from reference clips and performs multi-speaker dialogue and multi-character scenes in a single pass, with explicit control over line boundaries; a character’s lines may be in different languages, in the same voice.

Editing and Long-Form Synthesis. The model replaces a word or a sentence inside existing speech while keeping the surrounding audio, and synthesizes long-form audio line by line or in streaming mode. [...] In this report, we present Fish Audio Drama 3, a speech generation model built around directed performance.
Drama 3 keeps the discrete audio tokenizer of S2 and redesigns the model, the task formulation, and the post-training objective around it.
